instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across the front of your shoulders in a front-rack position with elbows pointing slightly forward.
Bend your knees into a shallow quarter-dip, keeping your torso upright and heels down.
Explosively extend your hips and knees to drive upward, using that leg-drive momentum to press the bar off your shoulders.
Continue pressing with your arms until the bar is locked out fully overhead.
Lower the bar back to the shoulders under control and repeat.
Lie on your side with your legs stacked and extended, propped up on your forearm with your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Brace your core and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position, keeping your hips level and not letting them sag or rotate forward or back.
Hold for the prescribed time, then repeat on the other side.
Lie on your side with your legs stacked and fully extended, supporting your head with your top hand.
In one smooth motion, simultaneously raise your legs and lift your upper torso off the floor, bringing your ribs and hips toward each other.
Squeeze your obliques at the top of the movement, then lower back down under control to the starting position.
Complete the prescribed reps, then repeat lying on the other side.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell on the floor slightly in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, keeping your back flat, and grip the kettlebell handle with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward explosively to swing it up to roughly shoulder height, keeping that arm relaxed and straight.
Let the kettlebell swing back down between your legs under control, hinging at the hips again to absorb the momentum, and repeat.
Complete the set, then switch arms.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length in front of your hips, palms facing each other.
Bend your hips and knees to squat down, keeping your torso upright and the dumbbells together in front of you.
As you drive back up to standing, raise both arms out to your sides to shoulder height, forming a "T"/cross shape with your body at the top of the movement.
Lower the arms back down as you descend into the next squat, and repeat.
